newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent eases in correction from bullish IPE.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent eases in correction from bullish IPE.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures eased in correction from its last IPE close, brokers said on Wedensday.
November was traded at $24.44 per barrel, down 14 cents from its Tuesday's close on London's IPE at $24.58. A total of 25 lots were traded.
Brokers said levels might soften further, correcting from its bullish IPE trade on Tuesday.
Trade on London's IPE on Tuesday was overdone on the upside, said a broker.
They assessed support for the prompt month contract at $24.25-$24.40 and resistance at $25.00.
NYMEX crude for November was last traded at $25.39 per barrel, 15 cents below its last close of $25.54.
